name: Hanging Oblique Knee Raise
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a shoulder-width overhand grip, straight arms, and your legs extended together.
Brace your core and raise both bent knees up and across toward one shoulder while contracting that side of your waist.
Lower your legs smoothly back to the center hang under control.
Raise your knees toward the opposite shoulder, continuing to alternate sides on each repetition.
tips: Control the twist from your obliques rather than letting your body spin wildly beneath the bar.
Keep your shoulders stable and avoid bending your elbows to heave your hips upward.
